The '''Climbsuit''' was a set of light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was designed to help the wearer when climbing. It had knee and elbow pads, and gloves that were covered in [[FrictionGrip/Legends|FrictionGrip]]. It was designed to stick to smooth modern surfaces. It also included high-impact padding and an equipment harness.<ref name="ROE" />
